profiles.portable: Use provided models where suitable and documented datasheet-derived models for all remaining devices.
profiles.hybrid: Prefer locally installed official vendor models with verified adapters; otherwise use portable models and emit an explicit limitation.
profiles.vendor: Require official/exact models and verified terminal adapters. Any unresolved or incompatible model fails the build.

MCP6004T-I/ST.ngspice_compatibility: Official PSpice model preserved unchanged; hybrid/portable decks use a checksum-tracked ngspice syntax-normalised copy with only the R61 TC instance syntax translated.
MCP6004T-I/ST.wrapper: quad package split into four MCP6001 instances using physical MCP6004 pins
MCP6004T-I/ST.redistribution: Microchip model licence in file; use is restricted to Microchip products.
MCP6004T-I/ST.model_version_date: REV G; supplied file revision history includes dated revisions through 2012 and a later syntax-fix entry without a date

TLV7044PWR.ngspice_compatibility: Must be established by inspecting and smoke-testing the downloaded package.
TLV7044PWR.wrapper: physical PW-14 pin mapper; each comparator channel is instantiated independently if the vendor model is single-channel
TLV7044PWR.redistribution: TI evaluation-item terms apply; do not commit downloaded package unless redistribution is confirmed.
TLV7044PWR.model_version_date: SLVMDH0 package; revision/date not encoded in the public package identifier

TLV7031DCKR.ngspice_compatibility: Must be established by actual package inspection and smoke test.
TLV7031DCKR.wrapper: DCK physical pins 1 OUT, 2 GND, 3 IN+, 4 IN-, 5 V+

TLV9001IDBVR.ngspice_compatibility: The public package is for TLV9002; adapter and channel extraction must be verified.
TLV9001IDBVR.wrapper: DBV physical pins 1 OUT, 2 V-, 3 IN+, 4 IN-, 5 V+

TLV9041IDBVR.ngspice_compatibility: Must be established by actual package inspection and smoke test.
TLV9041IDBVR.wrapper: normal TLV9041 DBV-5 physical pins 1 OUT, 2 V-, 3 IN+, 4 IN-, 5 V+; not the U variant

TS5A3166DCKR.ngspice_compatibility: HSPICE syntax conversion and a switching smoke test are required.
TS5A3166DCKR.wrapper: DCK physical pins 1 NO, 2 COM, 3 GND, 4 IN, 5 V+
TS5A3166DCKR.model_version_date: SCDJ032; revision/date not established until package inspection

TPS610995DRVR.ngspice_compatibility: Official package is unencrypted, but compatibility and terminal order must be verified in the installed package.
TPS610995DRVR.wrapper: DRV package physical pins 1 GND, 2 VOUT, 3 FB, 4 EN, 5 SW, 6 VIN; exposed pad 7 is tied to GND outside vendor model

REF3020AIDBZR.ngspice_compatibility: TINA macro-model may require manual extraction/conversion; strict mode must not assume compatibility.
REF3020AIDBZR.wrapper: Official DBZ physical pins are 1 IN, 2 OUT, 3 GND and match the KiCad export. The vendor TINA .SUBCKT terminal order is a separate inspection gate.

TPD1E05U06DPYT.package_name: Exact catalog part has IBIS and S-parameter models; TPD1E05U06-Q1 has SLVME60.ZIP PSpice transient model
TPD1E05U06DPYT.ngspice_compatibility: Exact catalog model is unavailable as a public transient SPICE model; use documented datasheet-derived model unless the Q1 model is separately validated.
TPD1E05U06DPYT.model_version_date: Exact-part transient SPICE unavailable; Q1 comparison package SLVME60

BSS138.ngspice_compatibility: Use exact onsemi model if installed and inspected; otherwise portable datasheet-derived MOSFET model.
BSS138.wrapper: KiCad physical pins are audited before mapping to D/G/S
BSS138.redistribution: Check onsemi model licence before committing.

MMBT3904.ngspice_compatibility: Provided model is from Diodes Incorporated, not the ordered Hottech part; exact-vendor mode rejects it.
MMBT3904.wrapper: SOT-23 physical pin mapping audited before C/B/E mapping
MMBT3904.redistribution: Diodes Incorporated licence is contained in provided file.
MMBT3904.model_version_date: Provided Diodes Incorporated model card; file contains no explicit release date

BAT54WS L9.known_limitations: No exact CJ transient model was supplied; leakage and capacitance are datasheet-derived.
BAT54WS L9.model_version_date: Datasheet-derived portable model; no vendor model version

1N4148WS.manufacturer: ST (supplier metadata; exact company identity ambiguous)
1N4148WS.ngspice_compatibility: Provided Diotec model is inspectable but does not match the netlist manufacturer metadata.
1N4148WS.model_version_date: Provided comparison model; version/date recorded only in source file if present

RB521S30T1G.known_limitations: Use official onsemi model if obtained and its orientation is verified; otherwise low-current Vf and capacitance are approximated.
RB521S30T1G.model_version_date: Datasheet-derived portable model; no installed vendor-model version

19-237/R6GHBHC-A01/2T.known_limitations: No official Everlight SPICE model was identified; red, green and blue junctions are modelled separately.

CR2032.manufacturer: unspecified cell; only holder LCSC C70377 is identified
CR2032.known_limitations: Battery chemistry cannot be vendor-correlated until the actual CR2032 cell manufacturer and type are fixed.
CR2032.model_version_date: Dynamic equivalent version 2026.07.29; exact cell manufacturer unresolved

ANR3015T2R2M.portable_model: direct L plus DCR, estimated parasitic capacitance and saturation warning
ANR3015T2R2M.known_limitations: No vendor nonlinear inductor model was supplied.
